download.title: Print agent
download.description: Install it on a store computer that is on every day (it can share the checkout computer), with sleep turned off. One agent can serve every receipt printer on the same local network; if the printers are on different networks, or you want each checkout to work independently, install one for each.

resetPairing.title: Pair "{name}" again
resetPairing.body: The old key stops working immediately and this computer must pair again with a new pairing code. Printer settings are kept.
resetPairing.doneBody: On the computer, right-click "重新配對.bat" (Pair again) in the installer folder, choose "Run as administrator", and paste the server URL and pairing code below. New computer, or the code expired before setup finished: run the installer on that computer instead and paste the same two values.
resetPairing.manualShow: Show manual command (Linux, Mac, or no "重新配對.bat")
resetPairing.manual: As an administrator, run print-agent pair --server (server URL) --code (new code) --force, then restart the print agent service (see "Pair again" in this page help).

disableAgent.title: Disable "{name}"?
disableAgent.body: Its key stops working immediately, its printers can no longer be chosen for printing, and waiting or sent print jobs are marked as failed. A disabled print agent can't be enabled again; to keep printing, add a new print agent and move the printers to it.
